result.brief: 提出 Connected Self Forcing 训练框架，通过 shortcut gradient replay 重连自回归视频分块间的梯度路径，提升长时序视觉质量与时间一致性且不改变推理流程。
result.reason: Training framework for autoregressive video generation reconnecting cross-chunk gradients; directly serves long-video autoregressive generation and its training efficiency.
